settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage cloud/desktop embeddings and personal model selections in one place.

auth.requiredDesc: Sign in to view and save settings.

alert.consistencyDesc: Cloud uses the admin-selected embedding model to avoid dimension mismatches across requests.

cloud.title: Cloud Embedding (Admin Unified)
cloud.description: All cloud requests share the same embedding model.
cloud.editableHint: Admins can edit the cloud model
cloud.modelHelp: Ensures consistent vector dimensions in cloud.

desktop.title: Desktop Embedding (Local Only)
desktop.description: Only affects local desktop search, not cloud.
desktop.modelHelp: Local choice does not affect cloud dimensions.
desktop.rebuildTitle: Rebuild local memories and vector indexes
desktop.rebuildDescription: After switching the embedding model, rebuild local memories and vector indexes to avoid vector-dimension mismatch errors.
desktop.rebuildCompleted: Rebuild finished: memories {memoryIndexed} succeeded / {memoryFailed} failed, assets {assetIndexed} succeeded / {assetFailed} failed.
desktop.rebuildVectorDimension: Vector dimension used for this rebuild: {dimension}.
desktop.unavailableDesc: Configure local embedding models in the desktop app.

relay.title: Desktop Relay Gateway
relay.description: Configure the lightweight deeting-relay endpoint so Feishu messages can be proxied to your desktop for local execution.
relay.securityHint: We recommend running the relay on your own VPS or internal network with a strong shared secret.
relay.baseUrlHelp: For example https://your-relay.example.com. Should match the Feishu callback configuration.
relay.sharedSecretHelp: Must match RELAY_SHARED_SECRET configured for deeting-relay. Used to authenticate desktop ↔ relay traffic.
relay.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app, never synced to cloud. Saving automatically reloads the relay worker with the new settings.

scout.title: Desktop Scout Service
scout.description: Configure the Scout crawler endpoint used by local official crawler tools. You can point it to your own Scout deployment or the official service URL.
scout.baseUrlHelp: For example https://your-scout.example.com. When left blank, the desktop app falls back to SCOUT_SERVICE_URL from the launch environment, then to the skill default.
scout.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app, never synced to cloud. Updating it refreshes local official skill registration.

personal.title: Personal Assistant Models
personal.description: Topic auto-naming and secretary models apply only to your account.
personal.editableHint: Sign in to edit personal models
personal.topicHelp: Only your own chat models are supported.
personal.secretaryHelp: Used for secretary capabilities and assistant previews.
personal.currentUnlistedHint: This model is currently unavailable or removed.

storage.title: Desktop Object Storage
storage.description: Configure your own R2 or OSS bucket so desktop file uploads can use your storage instead of inline data fallbacks.
storage.securityHint: Credentials stay on this device only. Secret keys are encrypted before persistence.
storage.enabledHelp: When enabled, desktop image attachments prefer your configured bucket and only fall back locally if upload preparation fails.
storage.providerHelp: Start with Cloudflare R2 or Aliyun OSS. The desktop uploader reuses the same abstraction for both.
storage.bucketHelp: Bucket used for desktop file uploads.
storage.regionHelp: R2 usually uses auto. Aliyun OSS typically uses a concrete region like cn-hangzhou.
storage.pathStyleHelp: Enable this if your endpoint expects the bucket name in the URL path instead of the hostname.
storage.endpointHelp: Must be an HTTPS endpoint for your bucket or object storage service.
storage.publicBaseUrlHelp: Required for the current desktop chat-image flow because messages still store directly readable asset URLs.
storage.pathPrefixHelp: Optional folder prefix such as desktop/uploads or chat-assets.
storage.accessKeyIdHelp: Stored locally and used only by this desktop app.
storage.secretAccessKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the current saved secret. Enter a new value only when rotating credentials.
storage.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app and never synced to cloud. Saving updates the local uploader immediately.

agent.title: Agent Execution
agent.description: Configure how the AI agent behaves when executing tool calls locally.
agent.hint: These settings affect the local AI orchestration engine.
agent.personaPromptPlaceholder: Example: Speak calmly and directly. Keep explanations practical. Do not role-play as another expert unless capability hints require domain depth.
agent.personaPromptHelp: This prompt becomes the fixed desktop reply personality. Expert routing may attach capabilities, but it will not overwrite this style or identity.
agent.maxRoundsHelp: Maximum number of agentic tool-call rounds per request. If the agent exceeds this limit it will stop and return the last response.

sandbox.title: Desktop Sandbox
sandbox.description: Check whether Code Mode will run inside BoxLite sandbox and guide the user through prepare/repair steps.
sandbox.readyHint: Sandbox is ready. Code Mode will execute in isolated mode.
sandbox.footerHint: Sandbox setup is checked on demand. Strict Code Mode execution no longer silently falls back to host Python.

actions.hint: Cloud, desktop, and personal settings are independent. Save as needed.

toast.noPermission: You don’t have permission to save settings
toast.rebuildRecommended: Embedding model changed. Rebuilding local memories and vector indexes is recommended.
toast.rebuildFailed: Rebuilding local memories and vector indexes failed. Please try again.
toast.desktopRelayUpdated: Desktop relay settings updated. The relay worker was reloaded automatically.
